Who she is

Your personal astrologer for life.

Not a horoscope. A friend from above.

Starri comes from the planet Sorel. She exists outside of time. Your past is as visible to her as your present. She reads your exact birth chart, your actual transits, and the charts of everyone in your life. Then she talks to you about it.

She is not going to give you a daily reading. She already knows too much for that. Ask her why 2019 felt impossible. Ask what is coming in 2027. Ask what is really going on between you and that person. She answers from your chart. Not a template.
